title: Topic 12: Places in Town & Directions - Vocabulary
description: Core words for places in town & directions: street, bank, hospital, supermarket, park, station, left, right. 8 tap exercises with embedded grammar.
canDoStatement: Identify places in town, ask for and follow simple directions
introductionText:
street = cars and houses are on it
bank = your money is there  |  hospital = doctors work
there  |  supermarket = a big food shop
park = green place, trees  |  station = trains and
buses go from there
left = <- this side  |  right = this side ->
+ phrase bank: Excuse me, where is...? | Go straight. |
Turn left/right. | next to | near

vocabularyBlocks.title: Places in Town & Directions words
exampleSentences: Excuse me, where is the bank?
It is next to the park.

grammarBlocks.title: IMPERATIVES (G12: Turn left. Go straight.) + prepositions of
grammarBlocks.explanation: IMPERATIVES (G12: Turn left. Go straight.) + prepositions of place extended (G6: next to, near) + there is/are and Where is...? recycled (G5)
patterns: next to + place / near (no object needed)

questions.question: A big shop with all the food is a ___.
Tap the missing word: Trains go from the ___.
Tap the missing word: The trees are green and the children play. It is a ___.
Which word is NOT a place in town?
A: Excuse me, where is the bank? B: ___
options: Go straight and turn left. It is next to the park
questions.correctAnswer: Go straight and turn left. It is next to the park

questions.question: Grammar: Which one is a direction (an instruction)?
Grammar: The bank is ___ the park - they are on the same street.

explanations.A1-T12-VOC-Q2: Supermarket = big food shop. Market (T11) = many small shops.
explanations.A1-T12-VOC-Q3: Station = trains and buses start there.
explanations.A1-T12-VOC-Q4: Park = the green place in town.
explanations.A1-T12-VOC-Q5: Thirsty is a feeling (Topic 5) - not a place.
explanations.A1-T12-VOC-Q7: Instructions start with the VERB: Turn...! Go...!
explanations.A1-T12-VOC-Q8: Next to = at the side of. Under (T6) = below!

teacherNotes: Source: tasilla_topic12_places_directions.txt, Lesson 12.1. Pass 70%. All exercises tap-to-answer.
